lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 116, for issue 115, which gives CI's verify job a 25-minute time budget.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request one sixteen, for issue one fifteen, which gives C I's verify job a twenty-five minute time budget.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what the PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
The verify job runs the smoke test, then every verify script, one after another.
Before each script, it checks that the script could finish inside the shared budget.
A script that doesn't fit is reported as not run, and verify fails.
This PR raises that budget from 15 to 25 minutes.
The step that runs the tests may now take 30 minutes instead of 20.
And the whole verify job may take 45 minutes instead of 30.
Every feature PR adds a script. After PR 113 the tests took 776 seconds of 900, and PR 114 pushed two scripts out.
lines.say: Every feature pull request adds a script. After pull request one thirteen, the tests took seven hundred seventy-six seconds of nine hundred, and pull request one fourteen pushed two scripts out.

lines.caption: The key fact: a script needs its full 120 seconds of budget left just to start.
lines.say: The key fact: a script needs its full hundred and twenty seconds of budget left just to start.

lines.caption: The run step calls the verify-proof script, which runs each test with its own virtual screen and a 120-second limit.
lines.say: The run step calls the verify proof script, which runs each test with its own virtual screen and a hundred and twenty second limit.

lines.caption: The check adds the time used so far to that limit, and compares it with the budget. It doesn't change.
A skipped script fails the job, because a test that never ran proves nothing.
The budget goes from 900 to 1500 seconds, leaving roughly 12 more minutes for new scripts.
lines.say: The budget goes from nine hundred to fifteen hundred seconds, leaving roughly twelve more minutes for new scripts.

lines.caption: The step's limit must be over 27 minutes, the budget plus one last script, or GitHub would cancel it first.
The job's limit also covers installing the packages and uploading the screenshots.
On main after PR 113, every test ran, with about 26 seconds to spare.
lines.say: On main after pull request one thirteen, every test ran, with about twenty-six seconds to spare.

lines.caption: PR 114 added one more script, and the last two were not run.
lines.say: Pull request one fourteen added one more script, and the last two were not run.

lines.caption: With this PR, a script may start up to 1380 seconds into the run, and on PR 116 all 18 tests ran.
lines.say: With this pull request, a script may start up to thirteen hundred eighty seconds into the run, and on pull request one sixteen all eighteen tests ran.

lines.caption: The cost: every new script makes every code PR's verify run longer.
And a bigger budget lets a slow script go unnoticed for longer.
The issue's optional extras, a slow-script warning and a budget-left line, are not in this PR.
The PR changes the verify script, the workflow and CLAUDE.md, and adds this explainer.
To undo it, revert the PR; verify goes back to 15 minutes.
Part 2. How it was built and verified: read and parsed here, then run by CI on PR 116.
lines.say: Part 2. How it was built and verified: read and parsed here, then run by C I on pull request one sixteen.

lines.caption: The numbers come from PR 113's verify run, which took 776 seconds.
lines.say: The numbers come from pull request one thirteen's verify run, which took seven hundred seventy-six seconds.

lines.caption: And from PR 114's failing run, where two scripts were not run.
lines.say: And from pull request one fourteen's failing run, where two scripts were not run.

lines.caption: Reading the commit showed only the limits changed, not the check.
The script still parses, and the workflow's new timeouts read back as 45 and 30 minutes.
A search found no old 15-minute or 900-second values left.
lines.say: A search found no old fifteen-minute or nine hundred second values left.

lines.caption: There is no Thunar test or screenshot, because no Thunar code changed.
CI's verify job on PR 116 ran the smoke test and all 17 scripts, and all 18 passed, none cut for time.
lines.say: C I's verify job on pull request one sixteen ran the smoke test and all seventeen scripts, and all eighteen passed, none cut for time.

lines.caption: The two scripts PR 114 lost both ran, in 29 and 22 seconds.
lines.say: The two scripts pull request one fourteen lost both ran, in twenty-nine and twenty-two seconds.

lines.caption: The visual check audited all 158 screenshots of that run, and passed.
lines.say: The visual check audited all one hundred fifty-eight screenshots of that run, and passed.

lines.caption: Build, explainer and review were green on the same head.
Before the first push, a fresh agent reviewed the branch at the high level. It fixed nothing and skipped five findings.
Two say the tests still run one after another, on every PR. Both go into a follow-up issue.
One was the missing explainer, which is this page.
One says local runs are cut off at 10 minutes, also for the follow-up issue.
And one says the job's 45 minutes should do, unless installs without the cache prove slow.
lines.say: And one says the job's forty-five minutes should do, unless installs without the cache prove slow.

lines.caption: CI's first review of PR 116 found four low, plausible findings, and the owner accepted all four.
lines.say: C I's first review of pull request one sixteen found four low, plausible findings, and the owner accepted all four.

lines.caption: R1: the job leaves about 15 minutes beyond the run step. The worst case is about 43, and this PR widens the margin.
lines.say: R one: the job leaves about fifteen minutes beyond the run step. The worst case is about forty-three, and this pull request widens the margin.

lines.caption: R2: the budget check ignores a few seconds of cleanup. That's seconds, and it predates this PR.
lines.say: R two: the budget check ignores a few seconds of cleanup. That's seconds, and it predates this pull request.

lines.caption: R3: local runs stop at 10 minutes. That predates this PR too, and joins the follow-up issue.
lines.say: R three: local runs stop at ten minutes. That predates this pull request too, and joins the follow-up issue.

lines.caption: R4: the scripts still run in turn. Issue 115 asks for just the budget; parallel runs go to the follow-up.
lines.say: R four: the scripts still run in turn. Issue one fifteen asks for just the budget; parallel runs go to the follow-up.

lines.caption: Then PR 114 reruns on top, with its new script and the two that were skipped.
lines.say: Then pull request one fourteen reruns on top, with its new script and the two that were skipped.

lines.caption: How much budget is left can only be read from each later run's time.
Links to the issue and both runs are at the end of Part 2.
PR 116 carries CI's comments: the summary, code review, verify and this explainer.
lines.say: Pull request one sixteen carries C I's comments: the summary, code review, verify and this explainer.

lines.caption: Part 3. What comes later: PR 114 reruns on top, and a follow-up issue takes on what's left.
lines.say: Part 3. What comes later: pull request one fourteen reruns on top, and a follow-up issue takes on what's left.

lines.caption: PR 116 raises the budget.
lines.say: Pull request one sixteen raises the budget.

lines.caption: Next, PR 114, rename in place, reruns its verify on top of it.
lines.say: Next, pull request one fourteen, rename in place, reruns its verify on top of it.

lines.caption: With that through, batch 111 is done.
lines.say: With that through, batch one eleven is done.

lines.caption: Beside that chain, a follow-up issue will make verify faster.
First, run the verify scripts in parallel workers, so the budget stops filling up.
Second, on a PR, run only the scripts it changes.
lines.say: Second, on a pull request, run only the scripts it changes.

lines.caption: Third, run local checks in the background, past the 10-minute limit.
lines.say: Third, run local checks in the background, past the ten-minute limit.

lines.caption: In short: PR 116 gives verify 25 minutes, and all 18 tests fit again.
lines.say: In short: pull request one sixteen gives verify twenty-five minutes, and all eighteen tests fit again.
